ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider help-desk-driven MFA enrollment followed by immediate cloud sign-in
ucs.description: Hunts the signature Octo Tempest / UNC3944 / 0ktapus play: socially engineer a service desk into resetting MFA, register an attacker-controlled authenticator, and sign in from a new geography within minutes. Correlates an Entra ID 'User registered security info' / 'Add authentication method' audit event with a successful interactive sign-in for the same UPN inside a 60-minute window.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as reg_time max(_time) as last_reg from datamodel=Change where Change.action="modified" Change.object_category="user" (Change.change_type="AAD_MFA_register" OR Change.command IN ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Add registered authentication method","User registered all required security info")) by Change.user Change.src_user Change.result | rename Change.user as user Change.src_user as initiator Change.result as reg_result | where reg_result="success" | join type=inner user [ | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as signin_time max(_time) as last_signin values(Authentication.src) as src_ip values(Authentication.app) as app values(Authentication.signature) as signin_signature from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" Authentication.authentication_method!="federated" (Authentication.app="Azure Active Directory" OR Authentication.app="Office365" OR Authentication.app="AzureAD") by Authentication.user | rename Authentication.user as user ] | where signin_time >= reg_time AND signin_time <= reg_time + 3600 | eval delay_sec = signin_time - reg_time | table reg_time, signin_time, delay_sec, user, initiator, src_ip, app, signin_signature | sort - signin_time
ucs.kql:
let LookupWindow = 1h;
let MfaRegistrations = CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ApplicationId == 11161 or Application has_any ("Office 365","Azure Active Directory")
| where ActionType has_any ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Add registered authentication method","User registered all required security info","Update user.")
| extend Target = tolower(tostring(ActivityObjects[0].Name)),
         RawTarget = tostring(parse_json(RawEventData).ObjectId)
| extend Target = iif(isempty(Target), tolower(RawTarget), Target)
| where isnotempty(Target)
| project RegTime = Timestamp, Target, Initiator = AccountDisplayName, RegIP = IPAddress, ActionType;
AADSignInEventsBeta
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ErrorCode == 0
| where ClientAppUsed == "Browser"
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend AcctUpnLower = tolower(AccountUpn)
| join kind=inner MfaRegistrations on $left.AcctUpnLower == $right.Target
| where Timestamp between (RegTime .. RegTime + LookupWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, RegTime),
         NewIP = iif(IPAddress != RegIP, "yes", "no")
| project SigninTime = Timestamp, RegTime, DelaySec, AccountUpn, Country, City, IPAddress, RegIP, NewIP, Application, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, Initiator, ActionType
| order by SigninTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookupWindow = 1h;
let MfaRegistrations = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OperationName has_any ("User registered security info","Admin registered security info","Add registered authentication method","User registered all required security info")
| where Result == "success"
| extend Target = tolower(tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)),
         Initiator = tostring(parse_json(InitiatedBy).user.userPrincipalName),
         InitiatorIp = tostring(parse_json(InitiatedBy).user.ipAddress)
| where isnotempty(Target)
| project RegTime = TimeGenerated, Target, Initiator, InitiatorIp, OperationName;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType == 0
| where ClientAppUsed == "Browser"
| where IsInteractive == true
| extend UpnLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName),
         Country = tostring(parse_json(LocationDetails).countryOrRegion),
         City = tostring(parse_json(LocationDetails).city)
| join kind=inner MfaRegistrations on $left.UpnLower == $right.Target
| where TimeGenerated between (RegTime .. RegTime + LookupWindow)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', TimeGenerated, RegTime)
| project SigninTime = TimeGenerated, RegTime, DelaySec, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, City, AppDisplayName, RiskLevelDuringSignIn, Initiator, InitiatorIp, OperationName
| order by SigninTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:("User registered security info" OR "Admin registered security info" OR "Add registered authentication method" OR "User registered all required security info") @properties.result:success -@user.userPrincipalName:(*\#EXT\#* OR svc-*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog ActionType=/registered|MfaMethodRegistered|AuthenticationMethodAdded/i
| Result=success
| groupBy([UserPrincipal, _time], function=collect([SourceIpAddress, ActionType, InitiatorUserPrincipal]))
| join({#event_simpleName=IdpAuthenticationLog AuthenticationAction=Success ClientApp=Browser}, field=UserPrincipal, include=[SourceIpAddress, _time, ApplicationName], rename={SourceIpAddress: SigninIp, _time: SigninTime})
| diff := SigninTime - _time
| diff >= 0 AND diff <= 3600
| groupBy([UserPrincipal], function=collect([SourceIpAddress, SigninIp, ApplicationName, ActionType, diff]))

ucs.title: [LLM] Scattered Spider RMM tool sideloading for hands-on-keyboard persistence
ucs.description: Hunts execution of the curated list of remote management and monitoring (RMM) binaries that UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / Muddled Libra ships onto victim endpoints once they have an Entra ID foothold — including AnyDesk, ScreenConnect/ConnectWise Control, Splashtop, Tactical RMM, Atera, Pulseway, Ngrok, NinjaRMM, RustDesk, Action1, Fixme.it and Domotz. Optional fan-out clause raises severity when the same RMM is installed across multiple hosts in a short window — a signature of their post-compromise expansion phase.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents values(Processes.user) as users dc(Processes.dest) as host_count values(Processes.dest) as hosts from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.user!="*$" Processes.user!="SYSTEM" (Processes.process="*anydesk*" OR Processes.process="*AnyDesk*" OR Processes.process="*screenconnect*" OR Processes.process="*ScreenConnect*" OR Processes.process="*connectwisecontrol*" OR Processes.process="*ConnectWiseControl*" OR Processes.process="*splashtop*" OR Processes.process="*Splashtop*" OR Processes.process="*tacticalrmm*" OR Processes.process="*TacticalRMM*" OR Processes.process="*atera*" OR Processes.process="*AteraAgent*" OR Processes.process="*pulseway*" OR Processes.process="*Pulseway*" OR Processes.process="*ninjarmm*" OR Processes.process="*NinjaRMM*" OR Processes.process="*ngrok*" OR Processes.process="*rustdesk*" OR Processes.process="*RustDesk*" OR Processes.process="*action1*" OR Processes.process="*Action1*" OR Processes.process="*fixme*" OR Processes.process="*Domotz*" OR Processes.process="*domotz*" OR Processes.process="*level.io*" OR Processes.process="*Syncro*" OR Processes.process="*syncro*") by Processes.process_name Processes.dest | where host_count >= 1 | eval severity=if(host_count>=3,"high","medium") | sort - host_count - last_seen
ucs.kql:
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","connectwise-control","splashtop","tacticalrmm","meshagent","meshcentral","atera","ateraagent","pulseway","ninjarmmagent","ngrok","rustdesk","action1","fixme.it","domotz","level.io","syncro","itarian","teamviewer_service","logmein"]);
let RmmInstalls = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| where (FileName in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe","installer.exe","installutil.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe"))
    and ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
| extend MatchedTool = tostring(extract(@"(?i)(anydesk|screenconnect|connectwise[-]?control|splashtop|tacticalrmm|meshagent|meshcentral|atera|ateraagent|pulseway|ninjarmm|ngrok|rustdesk|action1|fixme\.it|domotz|level\.io|syncro|itarian|teamviewer_service|logmein)", 1, tolower(ProcessCommandLine)))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, MatchedTool, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession, SHA256;
let BaselineHosts = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp between (ago(60d) .. ago(7d))
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (RmmTokens)
| summarize by DeviceName;
RmmInstalls
| join kind=leftanti BaselineHosts on DeviceName
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            HostCount = dcount(DeviceName), Hosts = make_set(DeviceName, 20),
            Cmdlines = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            RemoteSession = make_set(IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession)
            by MatchedTool, AccountName
| extend Severity = iff(HostCount >= 3, "high", "medium")
| order by HostCount desc, LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let RmmTokens = dynamic(["anydesk","screenconnect","connectwisecontrol","connectwise-control","splashtop","tacticalrmm","meshagent","meshcentral","atera","ateraagent","pulseway","ninjarmm","ngrok","rustdesk","action1","fixme.it","domotz","level.io","syncro","itarian","teamviewer_service","logmein"]);
let RmmInstalls = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountType == "User"
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where tolower(CommandLine) has_any (RmmTokens)
| extend MatchedTool = tostring(extract(@"(?i)(anydesk|screenconnect|connectwise[-]?control|splashtop|tacticalrmm|meshagent|meshcentral|atera|ateraagent|pulseway|ninjarmm|ngrok|rustdesk|action1|fixme\.it|domotz|level\.io|syncro|itarian|teamviewer_service|logmein)", 1, tolower(CommandLine)))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, MatchedTool;
let BaselineHosts = SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(60d) .. ago(7d))
| where EventID == 4688
| where tolower(CommandLine) has_any (RmmTokens)
| summarize by Computer;
RmmInstalls
| join kind=leftanti BaselineHosts on Computer
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            HostCount = dcount(Computer), Hosts = make_set(Computer, 20),
            Cmdlines = make_set(CommandLine, 10)
            by MatchedTool, Account
| extend Severity = iff(HostCount >= 3, "high", "medium")
| order by HostCount desc, LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Scattered Spider RMM Tool Deployment
id: 7b5e2a6c-f4d1-4a3e-9c2f-3a8d5f01b4d9
status: experimental
description: Detects installation or first-run of the remote management and monitoring (RMM) tools repeatedly observed in UNC3944 / Octo Tempest / Scattered Spider hands-on-keyboard intrusions for persistent C2 over legitimate vendor channels.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/10/25/octo-tempest-crosses-boundaries-to-facilitate-extortion-encryption-and-destruction/
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-320a
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1219.002
  - attack.t1133
  - attack.g1015
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'anydesk'
      - 'AnyDesk'
      - 'screenconnect'
      - 'ScreenConnect'
      - 'connectwisecontrol'
      - 'ConnectWiseControl'
      - 'splashtop'
      - 'Splashtop'
      - 'tacticalrmm'
      - 'TacticalRMM'
      - 'meshagent'
      - 'MeshAgent'
      - 'atera'
      - 'AteraAgent'
      - 'pulseway'
      - 'Pulseway'
      - 'ninjarmm'
      - 'NinjaRMM'
      - 'ngrok'
      - 'rustdesk'
      - 'RustDesk'
      - 'action1'
      - 'Action1'
      - 'fixme.it'
      - 'domotz'
      - 'Syncro'
  filter_legit_servicedesk:
    User|startswith:
      - 'NT AUTHORITY\\'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\\TrustedInstaller.exe'
  condition: selection_cmd and not filter_legit_servicedesk
fields:
  - Image
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Authorized MSP / IT operations team deploying approved RMM tooling — allowlist via service account or signed installer SHA256
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@CommandLine:(*anydesk* OR *AnyDesk* OR *ANYDESK*) OR @CommandLine:(*screenconnect* OR *ScreenConnect* OR *connectwisecontrol* OR *ConnectWiseControl*) OR @CommandLine:(*splashtop* OR *Splashtop*) OR @CommandLine:(*tacticalrmm* OR *TacticalRMM*) OR @CommandLine:(*meshagent* OR *MeshAgent* OR *meshcentral*) OR @CommandLine:(*atera* OR *Atera* OR *AteraAgent*) OR @CommandLine:(*pulseway* OR *Pulseway*) OR @CommandLine:(*ninjarmm* OR *NinjaRMM*) OR @CommandLine:(*ngrok* OR *Ngrok*) OR @CommandLine:(*rustdesk* OR *RustDesk*) OR @CommandLine:(*action1* OR *Action1*) OR @CommandLine:*fixme.it* OR @CommandLine:(*domotz* OR *Domotz*) OR @CommandLine:(*syncro* OR *Syncro*)) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| regex("(anydesk|screenconnect|connectwise[-]?control|splashtop|tacticalrmm|meshagent|meshcentral|atera(agent)?|pulseway|ninjarmm|ngrok|rustdesk|action1|fixme\\.it|domotz|level\\.io|syncro|itarian|teamviewer_service|logmein)", field=CommandLine, flags="i", strict=false)
| matched_tool := regex("(?i)(anydesk|screenconnect|connectwise[-]?control|splashtop|tacticalrmm|meshagent|meshcentral|atera|pulseway|ninjarmm|ngrok|rustdesk|action1|fixme\\.it|domotz|level\\.io|syncro|itarian|teamviewer_service|logmein)", field=CommandLine, group=1)
| groupBy([matched_tool, UserName], function=[count(field=aid, distinct=true, as=host_count), collect([ComputerName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], limit=20), min(_time, as=first_seen), max(_time, as=last_seen)])
| host_count >= 1
| severity := if(host_count >= 3, then="high", else="medium")
| sort(host_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: The set of RMM binaries hard-coded into this rule maps to the exact tools Microsoft (Octo Tempest), CrowdStrike (Scattered Spider), Mandiant (UNC3944), and Palo Alto Unit42 (Muddled Libra) have published as their preferred living-off-the-cloud persistence channel — the actor avoids custom malware specifically to blend with MSP tooling traffic.
